newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to auction C$2.4 bln bonds due 2007.
newsitem.headline: Canada to auction C$2.4 bln bonds due 2007.

text.p: The Government of Canada said it plans to auction on May 7 a total C$2.4 billion of bonds with a coupon of 7.25 percent and maturing on June 1, 2007.
The Bank of Canada will buy a minimum of C$360 million and holds C$122 million of bonds maturing May 15.
The bonds, which will be dated and delivered on May 15, pay interest on June 1 and December 1. The bonds will be issued with accrued interest from December 1, 1996 to May 15, 1997.
Proceeds of the issue will be used to help redeem C$876 million of government bonds maturing May 15.
The new bonds are in addition to C$7.1 billion of 7.25 percent bonds due June 1, 2007 already outstanding.
